thread.title: What PNC's Co-Chief Investment Strategist Is Watching During Earnings Season

author: Katherine Ross
title: What PNC's Co-Chief Investment Strategist Is Watching During Earnings Season
text:
What are you watching in earnings season?
Amanda Agati, co-chief investment strategist at PNC, talked to TheStreet about the fourth quarter earnings season, which kicked off this week.
Trading Strategies: What to Watch During Apple, Amazon and Facebook's Earnings Big tech names such as Facebook ( FB ) , Apple ( AAPL ) , Tesla ( TSLA ) and Amazon ( AMZN ) are just some of the companies reporting this week.
Investing Is a 'Constant Learning Game' According to M1 Finance CEO Here's what Agati is watching:
So Q4 earning season is really sort of interesting in particular. I think the most important thing is to understand forward guidance. So coming into the end of the year, we saw a significant pattern of negative earnings revisions and it really sort of freaked out the market. But in sort of looking at it relative to patterns over the last five years or so, the negative revisions that we experienced were very much in line with sort of those average trends. And so you know, we really want to understand for Q4 earnings what this year is going to look like. So guidance will be really important.
